title: Kissed Charred Indian Paneer Tikka
description: A kid-friendly Indian dish featuring charred and molten paneer, lightly flavored with rum, air-fried to perfection, this Kerala-inspired dish is raw-friendly and served in a paneer tikka form.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the yogurt, garam masala, cumin powder, coriander powder, cayenne pepper, and salt.
Add the paneer cubes to the bowl and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with a lid and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to marinate.
Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Remove the paneer from the marinade and cook in the air fryer for 5 minutes, shaking halfway through.
Brush the paneer with olive oil and cook for an additional 2 minutes, until lightly charred.
In a small bowl, mix together the light rum and lemon juice.
Brush the rum and lemon mixture onto the charred paneer.
Serve the paneer tikka hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
